page.layout: No printed text. The scan shows only a library label, a circular stamp and a digitiser's watermark, which are not transcribed.
page.notes: The rectangular label reads "BIBLIOTECA NAZ. Vittorio Emanuele III", with shelf mark "XXIV C 47" and "NAPOLI". It is a library label, not printed text. The circular stamp is partly legible ("...Calabro", "...libri") and is a library stamp. The faint text at the bottom right is a digitiser's watermark. Scattered specks are stains.
